name: Robert Gonzales
office: San Gabriel Valley Municipal Water District, Member, Board of Directors, Division 5

items.text: Robert Gonzales is an Azusa City Councilmember and former Mayor. He serves as Vice-Chairman of the San Gabriel Basin Water Quality Authority and is a board member of the Azusa Light & Water Agency. His campaign says he supports protecting water quality and the environment.
